purpose: Teach: 市政/不正確/手引き/ライフサイクル/移設/定率/不払い/ファクス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、市政との対話を大切にされた
lines.en: When Father founded the company, he always made a point of genuine dialogue with the city.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. Slow, measured pace. The voice of someone recalling something sacred but familiar. Slight lift on the name, then settling deeper into the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは不正確な広告を許されなかった
lines.en: Yes. Father would never tolerate false advertising—not once.
lines.style: Direct and steady. A son confirming something he learned early and internalized. Quiet firmness on the refusal. Not defensive, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、自ら社員手引きをお書きになった
lines.en: He wrote the employee handbook himself, you know.
lines.style: Soft wonder underneath. The tone of someone still moved by a parent's care made visible. Gentle pace. Eyes slightly distant, seeing the act itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品ライフサイクルを的確に予測された
lines.en: Yes. Father had a remarkable eye for where the market was heading—years ahead of most.
lines.style: Admiring but grounded. Not exaggeration, just clear sight. A measured nod in the voice. Slight pause after 'Father' as if gathering the precise word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社移設を断行された
lines.en: And he made the decision to relocate the headquarters—that took real courage.
lines.style: Quieter now, reflective. The voice of someone understanding only later what a risk that was. Slight trailing warmth on 'courage.' Respectful slowness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは定率昇給制度を導入された
lines.en: Yes. He was one of the first to see what fax machines could do for a business like ours.
lines.style: Calm, observational. A son bearing witness to foresight that looked ordinary at the time. Steady rhythm. No embellishment, just the quiet confidence of someone who saw it work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、不払い案件にも誠実に対応された
lines.en: Even when clients couldn't pay, he handled it with integrity. Never cut corners there.
lines.style: Quiet weight on this one. The voice slows. 'Integrity' lands clear. A son saying something he learned not from words but from watching. Respectful trailing-off.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはファクスの導入を最初期に決められた
lines.en: Yes. And he introduced the fixed-raise system long before other companies thought to do it.
lines.style: A final nod of confirmation. Warm beneath the surface. The voice of someone closing a conversation with quiet certainty. Even pace. The small satisfaction of a legacy understood.
